decisions.reason: The source makes TOC pagination contingent on the book size being fixed, but it does not select or change the paperback format or trim size.
The timing of TOC page-number updates does not change Chapter 18 heading typography or heading consistency.
The source does not change which chapter images are included, how they are identified, or where they are placed.
The source concerns pagination timing and does not modify image aspect-ratio preservation or cropping requirements.
The publication attribution line remains unaffected by when TOC page numbers are added.
The source does not alter the approved title text or the constraint excluding the unintended newline marker.
The source does not change permitted image sources, suitability review, or image-selection criteria.
The pagination timing decision does not resolve or change the cover image count, cover text, or existing cover-design ambiguity.
The source provides a narrow pagination procedure and does not change the requested publishing-readiness guidance or its prerequisite topics.
The timing for adding TOC page numbers does not alter the authoritative manuscript, accepted passages, tracked edits, or table punctuation.
The source does not change the required back matter or author biography content.
The pagination timing decision does not change the manuscript's copyediting, sentence-clarity, or meaning-preservation requirements.
